decisionsTitle: «Include programul evenimentului» — the organizers' message to an event's participants can carry the event's programme
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-17, on a phone, four days before Saturday's race, writing the race week's message to every participant — minutes after that message got the club's Facebook and Instagram links (§957):** «Vreau încă o bifă in acel eveniment de "include program"».

**What was there.** «Trimite un mesaj participanților» (§364) sends the organizers' own words, and three ticks put something of the platform's under them: «Cere reconfirmarea» (the button «Vin»), «Trimite și numărul de concurs și codul QR» (§943) and «Trimite și linkul pentru semnarea declarației» (§947). The event's programme — the timed rows of `events.schedule_items` (§117): at what hour the kits are handed out, when the start is — was in three other messages, as the «Program» row of the facts block (§392: the confirmation, the reminder, the declaration request), and on the event's page. In the organizers' message it was one link, «Programul evenimentului», to that page: to say the hours in the message itself the organizers typed them into the body, twice — once a language — and corrected them there by hand when the programme moved.

**Decision.** One more tick in the composer, beside the others and off by default: **«Include programul evenimentului»**, with one line of help — «Sub cuvintele tale apare programul evenimentului, oră cu oră, așa cum e pe pagina lui.» Ticked, every email of the send carries, under the organizers' words — and under the number and the desk code when §943's tick is on too — one outlined block with the single row «Program»: the event's timed rows, «08:30–09:30 — Ridicarea kiturilor (Sala Sporturilor)», the day before the hour when they span several days, each half of the message in its own language, in the HTML and in the plain text. Unlike the other three ticks it is about nobody in particular: it goes to every recipient of the send, whatever their state, and on the club's copy (§419), which shows what the participants got. The question before «Trimite» says it in one line — «Emailul include programul evenimentului.» — and the preview shows it as soon as the box is ticked.

**Why a tick, and not always.** The owner asked for a tick. And the organizers' message is whatever the organizers need it to be — a storm warning, a changed car park, two sentences on the morning of the race: a programme under every one of them would bury the words the message was sent for, and the facts line and the link to the page's programme are there already. The message that wants it is the one written in the race's week, and that one ticks the box.

**Why the facts block's own row.** The programme is already said one way in a participant's inbox — the «Program» row of the confirmation and the reminder — and a second wording of the same hours would be a second thing to keep right. So the row has one builder (`domain/event-facts.ts#programmeRow`), which the facts block and this message's block (`eventProgrammeBlock`) both call: the same label («Program» / "Programme", the page's own word — no second one was added), the same lines, the same box. The message does not become one of the messages that carry the whole block (`EVENT_FACTS_MESSAGES`): its bold facts line stays, and its links list stays whole — the event's page, its programme, its rules, «Înscrierile mele», the club's pages — where the full block would have taken the page's own links out of it.

**Read when the email leaves, not when the button is pressed.** The send writes a flag — `includeProgramme` — beside the words on every row it queues, and never the rows of the programme; the renderer reads the event when each email leaves, as it reads every fact of an event in a message. A send drains over hours (§40, §605): a row corrected after the press leaves as it now stands, in every email not yet gone — nobody is sent an hour the organizers have already changed. If the event has no timed row left by then, the email is exactly the one a send without the tick produces. The read is the public one, so a row's own place is not said while the event's place is to be announced (§328), in this block as in the facts block.

**Offered only when there is something to include.** The box is enabled when the event has at least one timed row. With none it is drawn disabled, with one sentence in the help's place: «Evenimentul nu are încă un program cu ore. Îl adaugi în editorul evenimentului, la „Programul zilei și ce să aduci”.» — the editor's card named by its own title, read from the catalogue, so the sentence cannot name a card the editor does not have. A programme written only as free text under the rows does not count: the message draws timed rows, as the facts block does. A disabled box posts nothing, and a flag forged onto a send for such an event draws nothing either, for the reason an emptied programme draws nothing.

**What the tick does not touch.** No state, place, hold, deadline, number or token: the send writes the flag, and its audit row names the tick (`includeProgramme` — never the rows, never who). No other message type reads the flag, whatever its payload holds. Who may send is as before (`canMessageParticipants`, BR-REQ-060-01).

**After a trial.** A send to the people ticked (§945) hands its words and its ticks back to the composer, so that a trial is followed by the same message to everybody. This tick comes back with them: a trial that showed the programme must not be followed by a message to everybody that has silently lost it. That is the only memory the tick has.

**Not done.** The whole facts block (place, route, cost, links) under the organizers' words — the message keeps its facts line and its links; the programme's free text (`schedule_json`), which stays on the page behind «Programul evenimentului»; a tick remembered from one message to the next — every new message starts with it off, and only the page that comes back from a trial holds it as that trial left it; a line on «Mesaje trimise» saying that a send carried the programme (its audit row does); the programme in the volunteers' messages; the update notice, which has its own programme sentence when the programme is what changed (§331).

**Held by** `tests/unit/notifications/organizer-message-programme.test.ts` (the flag's reader; the one builder — the facts block's row and the block alone say the same; the block in the message, each half in its own language, after the words and after §943's lines; the ticked message with its blocks taken out is the unticked one, byte for byte; no rows, no block; the club's copy; every other message type the same with the flag and without; the words in both catalogues; the files that may name the flag), `tests/integration/notifications/participant-message-programme.test.ts` (the send flags every row of every audience and state and names the tick in its audit row, and nothing when unticked; the email as it leaves; a row changed between the press and the render is the one that leaves; no timed row left, the unticked message; a row's place withheld with the event's; the club's copy; a forged flag on another type; the preview; the action, the people ticked and the tick handed back after a trial) and `participant-message-programme-page.test.ts` (the composer's page rendered in Romanian and in English: the tick enabled with rows, disabled with its sentence without, a free-text programme alone not enabling it; the question's line only for a press that posts the tick); in a browser, `tests/e2e/participant-message.spec.ts`.
changelogLine: - **«Include programul evenimentului» in «Trimite un mesaj participanților»** — one more tick in the composer: every email of the send then shows the event's programme, hour by hour, under your words, in both languages; the preview shows it, the question before «Trimite» says it, and for an event without a timed programme the tick is greyed and says where to add one. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 27 (what the platform adds under the organizers' words): given the composer of «Trimite un mesaj participanților», then it offers the tick «Include programul evenimentului», off by default, enabled only while the event has at least one timed programme row and otherwise drawn disabled with a sentence saying why and where the programme is written (a free-text programme alone does not enable it). Given a send with it ticked, then every row the send queues — every audience, every registration state, a test row too — and the club's copy carry the flag `includeProgramme`, never the programme's rows, and the send's audit row names the tick; an unticked send writes neither. Given an ORGANIZER_MESSAGE whose row carries the flag, when it renders, then each half carries, after the organizers' words (and after the number and the desk code of a send that also ticked «Trimite și numărul de concurs și codul QR»), one block with the single row «Program» in that half's own language — the facts block's own row, built by the same function, in the HTML and in the plain text — from the event's timed rows as they are when the message leaves, without a row's place while the event's place is to be announced; with no timed row then, the message is exactly the unticked one. The facts line, every link of the links list, the buttons and the closing are the same with and without the tick; the full facts block is not drawn; no other message type draws the block from the flag; the composer's preview draws it, in the tab's language first, from the rows as they are now when the box is ticked and is unchanged when it is not; and the question before «Trimite» says in one line that the email includes the event's programme, only for a press that posts the tick. Verification: unit `notifications/organizer-message-programme.test.ts`; integration `notifications/participant-message-programme.test.ts`, `notifications/participant-message-programme-page.test.ts`; e2e `participant-message.spec.ts` (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
